summary: {clerk} keeps one date for the proposed hearing-aid rule and another for the final decision.
realLife: Section 709 gave HHS three years to propose regulations and started a separate 180-day deadline when public comments closed.
inGame: needs: enactment, proposed-rule publication and docket closure dates.

turns.pulledBy: The docket closes on a recorded date.
turns.what: The clerk finds the docket entry ending public comment.
turns.writesBack: Staff can give the member a due date for the final rule.

turns.pulledBy: The hearing only establishes when the proposal appeared.
turns.what: The published notice contains only the proposal date.
turns.writesBack: The clerk requests the closing notice before calculating the second deadline.
